algorithm.decodedFrames: complete deterministic RGB decode; governing endpoints are physical n=0 and n=frameCount-1

sourceSampleContract.first: physical frame n=0 at its ffprobe best-effort presentation timestamp
sourceSampleContract.last: physical frame n=frameCount-1 at its ffprobe best-effort presentation timestamp
sourceSampleContract.policy: compiler must consume the emitted per-video authoredSourceSeconds; nominal FPS time is evidence, not the authoritative presentation timestamp

legacySeekDiagnostic.policy: retained only to expose which physical frame the former enrichment input seek resolves to

algorithm.normalization: center-crop Reference to decoded video aspect; resize video and Reference to 256x256 Lanczos RGB
algorithm.ssim: 11x11 valid-window BT.709-luma SSIM; K1=0.01, K2=0.03, L=255
algorithm.hashes: 64-bit bilinear aHash, dHash, and 32x32 DCT pHash
algorithm.decision: all thresholds must pass for each physical terminal endpoint; both n=0 and n=frameCount-1 must certify the job
